newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises Wed firm peak power by $4.25 per MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises Wed firm peak power by $4.25 per MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for firm power during peak demand hours on Wednesday by $4.25 per megawatt hour (MWH), the agency said Monday.
BPA also continued to refrain from offering non-firm power during morning and evening peaks and from offering any displacement power for Wednesday.
BPA offered up to 300 megawatts of firm peak power on Wednesday at $16.75 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $17.75 for California-Oregon border (COB).
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
Non-firm shoulder hour (0600-0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2300 PST) offers for Wednesday were unchanged at $10.50 for Northwest and $11.50 for COB.
